subject: Vendor onboarding: bank info & PO remittance field alignment
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@redwoodsupply.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: accounts@redwoodsupply.com
Date: 2026-05-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: bank info & PO remittance field alignment

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier — excited to get Redwood Supply set up in your procurement system. Attached are our standard onboarding docs (W-9 + banking instructions). Before we complete the packet, can you confirm the preferred remittance string you require on invoices and PO acknowledgements?

Specifically:
- Do you need PO# in a separate remittance field or embedded in the invoice memo?
- Any required label for the remit_to field (e.g., "Remit To", "Payment To", or a specific tag)?
- Do you accept ACH micro-deposits for verification or do you require a bank letter/voided check for wired accounts?

Attached: W9_SupplyCo.pdf, redwood_bank_instructions.pdf

We prefer ACH (faster, fewer fees) and can provide a bank letter if needed. If you can send the vendor onboarding packet or a DocuSign link, we’ll complete and return same day.

Thanks,
Samantha Ortiz
Acct Ops | Redwood Supply Co.
S: 415-555-0192
[Attachment: W9_SupplyCo.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: redwood_bank_instructions.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@redwoodsupply.com>
Cc: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-11T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: bank info & PO remittance field alignment

Hi Samantha — thanks for sending these over. A few quick items from procurement/finance so we can finish onboarding: 

1) Verification items: we can accept either ACH micro-deposit verification OR a bank letter on company letterhead that includes account number and routing (bank-issued proof preferred for wires). A voided check is fine too.

2) Remittance mapping: our finance system supports two remittance flows:
   - Preferred: dedicated remittance field that contains "PO#: {po_number} | INV: {invoice_number} | REMIT_TO: {payee_name}"
   - Fallback: free-text invoice memo (we'll parse but may require manual reconciliation)

Please confirm whether Redwood Supply wants our preferred remittance label or if you require something custom. If custom, include an example string for a PO/invoice pair.

3) Legal/Tax: Priya — can you confirm if we need a scanned EIN letter beyond the W-9?

4) Next steps: I'll send our vendor onboarding packet (DocuSign) and loop Payments (Marissa) to complete the setup. Once we have the bank proof, we’ll kick off a micro-deposit or wire test and confirm remittance tags before first payment.

I’ll attach the onboarding packet here (vendor_onboarding_packet.docx) and share the DocuSign link in a follow-up.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Supplier Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_packet.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: accounts@redwoodsupply.com <accounts@redwoodsupply.com>

Date: 2026-05-12T08:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: bank info & PO remittance field alignment

Jonas / Team,

Thanks — attaching our bank letter and a sample invoice showing the remittance tags you asked about. We can use your preferred format exactly as: 

    PO#: 98765 | INV: 2026-0423 | REMIT_TO: Redwood Supply Co.

Bank proof attached (redwood_bank_instructions.pdf). We are fine with ACH micro-deposits for verification; please initiate when ready. For immediate wire support, our bank will accept wired payments to the account listed in the bank letter.

Sample remittance (for reference on invoices/POs):
    "REMIT_LABEL=Remit To: Redwood Supply Co.; PO=98765; INV=2026-0423; AMT=USD12500.00"

Please confirm receipt and the expected date for the micro-deposit test.

Thanks,
Samantha Ortiz
Acct Ops | Redwood Supply Co.
[Attachment: redwood_bank_instructions.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: accounts@redwoodsupply.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-12T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding: bank info & PO remittance field alignment

Hi Samantha — confirmed, thanks for the bank letter and remittance example. We’ve uploaded the bank proof to the vendor record and initiated an ACH micro-deposit verification today. Expected arrival: 2 business days.

For clarity on the remittance pipeline: we will pass the following canonical tag into our AP export files so your AR system can auto-match: 

    REMIT_TAG: "PO#: {po_number} | INV: {invoice_number} | REMIT_TO: Redwood Supply Co."

Your sample string (REMIT_LABEL=...) will also be accepted by our invoice parser, so no additional format changes required. First scheduled payment (if invoice processed) will be created after micro-deposit completes and verification returns green.

If you need a different PO label mapping for EDI or an alternate accounting string, let us know and we’ll add it to your vendor profile.

Welcome aboard — looking forward to working together.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Payments Ops | Redwood Inference
[Processed attachments: redwood_bank_instructions.pdf, W9_SupplyCo.pdf]
